verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a security and compliance platform with agent-driven automation (MCP server, service keys, Fieldwork AI agents collecting evidence on a schedule), so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents versioning, change review, or rollback for any automation. Policy draft publishing and control review history are adjacent features about documents and controls, not automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
